primitive_props.translation: All Confidential Information remains the sole property of the Discloser
Confidential Information is returned to the Discloser forthwith on demand
Confidential Information is returned to the Discloser upon termination of the other party's services
The Company ensures that AHPL patients cannot be identified in the Company's reports submissions and publications
Information relating to AHPL patients is Confidential Information of AHPL
Information that becomes public without breach of the agreement is not Confidential Information
Information independently developed by the Recipient is not Confidential Information
Information obtained by the Recipient from another source without breach of confidentiality is not Confidential Information
Information disclosed orally without being identified and confirmed as confidential within thirty days is not Confidential Information
Information disclosed with the Discloser's prior written approval is not Confidential Information
Information is not excluded from Confidential Information merely because some individual features fall within an exception
Each party maintains the other party's Confidential Information in confidence
Each party uses the other party's Confidential Information only for the Purpose
Each party makes no commercial use of the other party's Confidential Information
Each party does not use the other party's Confidential Information for the benefit of itself
Each party does not use the other party's Confidential Information for the benefit of a third party
Each party does not use the other party's Confidential Information to guide or conduct searches for any purpose
Each party does not copy the other party's Confidential Information except as reasonably necessary for the Purpose
Any copies of Confidential Information made for the Purpose are the property of the Discloser

Each party does not disclose the other party's Confidential Information to third parties except in confidence to persons who need to know for the Purpose
Persons receiving Confidential Information for the Purpose are obliged by contract not to disclose it
The Recipient enforces non-disclosure obligations at its expense upon the Discloser's request
Each party is responsible for its directors and employees who receive Confidential Information
Each party applies no lesser security measures to the other party's Confidential Information than to its own similar confidential information
The Company causes its relevant personnel to observe or be bound by the agreement terms
The Company is responsible and liable for breaches by its relevant personnel
The Recipient makes a disclosure of Confidential Information required by law
The Recipient gives the other party at least two business days notice of a legally required disclosure
The Recipient consults with the Discloser prior to a legally required disclosure to try to avoid it if legally possible
Within one month of completion of the Purpose the Recipient returns all materials containing the other party's Confidential Information
Within one month of receiving a written request the Recipient returns all materials containing the other party's Confidential Information
The Recipient certifies in writing that it complied with the return requirement
Each party remains bound by the confidentiality undertakings after completion of the Purpose
AHPL data provided to the Company remains the property of AHPL
The Company marks AHPL data as AHPL property on all media and documentation
The Company takes reasonable precautions and adequate measures to preserve integrity of AHPL data
The Company prevents corruption or loss damage or destruction of AHPL data
This agreement is terminated
AHPL directs the Company to erase AHPL data
The Company erases AHPL data and copies from the Company's systems when directed by AHPL
The Company instructs its agents and subcontractors to erase AHPL data and copies when directed by AHPL
Data acquired from AHPL is used only for the purposes of this agreement
Data acquired from AHPL is not further processed without AHPL prior consent
Data acquired from AHPL is not disclosed without AHPL prior consent
AHPL data is not transferred to a third party without AHPL prior written consent
The Company does not use AHPL data for any commercial or profit-generating purpose without prior written consent
Upon completion of the agreement AHPL data is returned to AHPL
Upon completion of the agreement AHPL data is disposed of under the Company's supervision in accordance with laws regulations and AHPL instructions
The parties comply with the Personal Data Protection Act 2012 at all times
No license is granted under either party's intellectual property rights by this agreement
Each party warrants its right to disclose its Confidential Information
Each party warrants its right to authorize the other party to use its Confidential Information for the Purpose
Each party keeps the existence and nature of this agreement confidential
No party uses the other party's name in publicity without prior written consent
Any breach of this agreement will result in irreparable harm to the Discloser
Monetary damages may not be an adequate remedy for a breach of this agreement
Monetary damages are not an adequate remedy for a breach of this agreement

primitive_props.translation: A party seeking remedy is entitled to seek equitable relief for a breach or threatened breach
The Recipient does not file copyright registrations or patent applications on Confidential Information
If the Recipient files registrations on Confidential Information then the Recipient assigns them to the Discloser without cost
Each party complies with all applicable laws and regulations in carrying out obligations under this agreement
Notices under this agreement are in writing
This agreement continues in force until terminated by mutual consent or by thirty days prior written notice
Clauses 1 to 8 and 11 to 15 and 17 to 21 survive termination
Neither party transfers rights obligations or benefits under this agreement to a third party without prior written consent of the other party
Any permitted assignee agrees in writing to comply with all agreement terms
Any assignment does not exceed the existing scope of this agreement
The parties use best endeavours to settle disputes informally by agreement
The parties act in good faith to resolve disputes
A dispute is not settled by mediation
If mediation is unsuccessful then the dispute is resolved by arbitration or court proceedings as elected by either party
The parties keep arbitration proceedings confidential
The parties comply with export laws and regulations
No data information program or deliverable is exported in violation of export laws
No data information program or deliverable is used for purposes prohibited by export laws
This agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties regarding its subject matter
This agreement does not create a partnership between the parties
This agreement is governed by the laws of the Republic of Singapore
The parties submit to the non-exclusive jurisdiction of the Courts of the Republic of Singapore for disputes in connection with this agreement
